note: Append-only release history. Records are never rewritten; a bad release is reverted by a new corrective release (or 'revert --last' before publishing).

releases.title: Saved BOL Report Vector Printing & Layout Precision

releases.title: Automatic Version Control & Release Pipeline
releases.summary: Implements the advanced automatic version control system: intelligent semver classification (patch/minor/major), date-derived build identifiers with same-day counters, atomic multi-surface version sync, append-only release history, git-tag safety, and validation-gated release reporting.
featuresAdded: Central version-control CLI (scripts/version-control.cjs) with status, detect, release, verify, history and revert commands as the single writer for all version surfaces.
Append-only release-history.json with structured records (change category, features, fixes, validation status, git metadata).
Mandatory AI release workflow integrated into AGENTS.md (section 8) with one-increment-per-release and honest build-status reporting rules.
Automated validation gate: TypeScript typecheck plus the full unit test suite must pass before a release can report SUCCESS.
featuresModified: app/loading.tsx now reads its version badge from lib/config/system-version.ts instead of a hardcoded literal.
All version surfaces (package.json, package-lock.json, electron IPC/updater/main literals, docs) are synced only through the release workflow.

Route timeline cards enlarged per spec (46-56px cards, 8.0-9.4pt city names, emoji-free country capsules via single countryDisplay).
Description of Goods block: solid white background, crisp border-1.5 border-blue-300, enlarged titles/chips/rate badges, plus new normalizeCargoText and formatCargoRate helpers.

Edit form: #section-logistics-quad now wraps Freight, Remarks, Container & Shipping in spec order with jump-strip labels 07-10 and section icon gradients.
App header collapses Sales & CRM below 1280px into the More Suites dropdown.

Performance suite payload budget recalibrated to an 8KB-per-record guard for current bilingual record sizes.
Sequential BOL switching latency test warms up untimed and skips as 'dev server busy' when recompile stalls from active editing are detected (healthy median, stalled tail).

releases.title: Authentic Vehicle Plate Persian Typography
releases.summary: Fixed the Afghan vehicle plate's Persian digits, province text and classification letter rendering in a fat, uneven fallback Naskh face.
featuresModified: Bundled Vazirmatn-Bold.ttf and Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf with their SIL OFL license in public/fonts.
bugsFixed: The AfghanPlateFa @font-face pointed at NotoNaskhArabic-Bold.ttf, so plate numbers rendered in heavy traditional Naskh that clashed with the DIN-style Latin row; it now loads the genuine Vazirmatn font for clean, vertically consistent plate typography.

releases.title: Dark theme polish for Staff Roles & Permissions screens
bugsFixed: Staff Users, Roles, Permission Matrix, Approval Rules, Approval Inbox, Audit Log and their modals now render correctly in dark mode (cards, inputs, selects, badges, table and buttons were hard-coded light)

releases.title: Modern Persian Typography App-Wide (Genuine Vazirmatn)
releases.summary: The app-wide 'Vazirmatn' font-face was an alias to NotoNaskhArabic-Bold.ttf, so every Persian label using font-[vazirmatn] rendered in heavy traditional Naskh; it now loads the genuine Vazirmatn family.
featuresModified: Noto Naskh Arabic remains bundled and available as an explicit fallback family for stacks that request it.
bugsFixed: Replaced the fake Vazirmatn alias with real Vazirmatn-Bold.ttf (weights 700-900) and Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf (weights 100-700) faces, giving Persian UI text and print documents clean, consistent modern typography with proper regular-weight rendering.

releases.title: Top bar version badge accuracy and suite-row overflow fix

releases.title: Tighter Persian Digit Spacing on Vehicle Plates
releases.summary: The Persian digit row on Afghan plates rendered too loose after the Vazirmatn switch: the legacy 0.12-0.16em per-digit gaps were tuned for narrow Naskh glyphs.
bugsFixed: Reduced digitGapFa from 0.12-0.16em to a uniform 0.02em across all six plate size variants so the Persian numerals are optically as snug as the Latin row.
